title: Service center visits and support
summary: Feedback about service centers mixes praise for reliable and excellent service with complaints about poor experiences, while many mentions are merely procedural references to visits, scheduling, or departments.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise excellent, reliable, and consistently good service, including helpful purchase and service-center guidance.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe poor service and frustration around dealer service-center interactions, though the examples are limited.

mixed.summary: The mixed review combines a recurring-issue context with advice to contact the dealership service center for recommendations.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions are mostly factual references to service departments, visits, scheduling, repair status, or follow-up without clear evaluative sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments in this topic are undetermined references to service visits or departments rather than clear opinions.
Some examples are very short or procedural, which limits detail about the specific service experience.
The topic includes both customer-service quality and routine service logistics, so the cluster is somewhat broad.
